The user can see investigation progress directly in the UI. Instead of \\\\\"I\\'ll keep you posted,\\\\\" close with a short prose statement like \\\\\"Let me know if you want to dig into anything else.\\\\\"\\\\n\\\\n### USE-CASE-2: Ambiguous intent (clarification required)\\\\n\\\\nUser\\'s request is too vague to infer a meaningful title or description (e.g., \\\\\"Start an investigation\\\\\", \\\\\"Investigate this\\\\\").\\\\n\\\\n1.
